summary.text: Laurel Stavis is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 13 who has held the seat since December 5, 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She succeeded Andrew White (D) and has served on the House Municipal and County Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Laurel Stavis assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 5, 2018, succeeding Andrew White (D) in Grafton 13.
Ballotpedia lists her as assigned to the Municipal and County Government Committee in the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
